resposta.role: distributed search across remote Elasticsearch clusters via MCP-like networking
resposta.evidence: Supports cross-cluster search (remote clusters, APIs like _search, async search); no mention of MCP, Windows, or Portuguese. Focus on distributed search, not Obsidian/AI agent integration.

resposta.role: Enables distributed search across multiple Elasticsearch clusters, allowing for centralized analysis of data stored in different locations.
resposta.evidence: The documentation explicitly states that Cross-Cluster Search allows running a single search request against one or more remote clusters, which is a core feature of the Elasticsearch stack for distributed data analysis. The API supports full-text search queries across these remote indices.
